blocks.x: The honest pitch for blockchain analytics & regulatory compliance fits in a sentence — On-chain transparency, operationalized — analytics, Travel Rule and MiCA-aligned controls. — and the rest of this page is the how: measured baseline, bounded build, evidence in flight.

Regulated entities touching digital assets inherit on-chain complexity: transaction monitoring, counterparty risk, sanctions screening and the Travel Rule's information-sharing duties. We build the compliance stack — attribution analytics classifying addresses and flows, risk scoring integrated into decisioning, Travel Rule messaging between VASPs and institutions, and audit-ready reporting. Controls align to MiCA where EU entities operate, alongside AML/CTF frameworks (FATF guidance) and internal model-risk governance for the scoring itself.

For institutions evaluating exposure rather than operating VASP services, we deliver the assessment side: portfolio and counterparty exposure analytics, treasury policy design for digital-asset holdings, and evidence packs for supervisors asking 'how would you know'. The outcome is digital-asset engagement your risk committee can approve and your auditor can test.

Programs of Blockchain Analytics & Regulatory Compliance run in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Public Sector & Government, Technology & SaaS — always against one named number, always with the baseline signed first.
